title: Private Sunset Boat Tour of Charleston Harbor
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
During your 2.5-hour tour you will witness the beauty that has made Charleston the #1 City in the World year after year. Impressive, but what is beauty without a little brawn! During the tour you will see the Yorktown, Fort Sumter, Fort Johnson, Fort Moultrie, Castle Pinkney, and the world renowned Battery and White Point Garden which housed the artillery during the Civil War. If you think all of that sounds amazing, just wait until you see the sunset. Experiencing the Charleston sunset from the water will leave you breathless! After you catch your breath, the sunset will serve as the perfect backdrop for family portraits, engagements, you name it!

Food and drink are encouraged! Alcohol is welcome for guests 21 and older. We provide the cooler and ice - aren’t we nice!

Music and boating are like a horse and carriage - They just go together! All our boats are equipped with a Bluetooth stereo system that makes us the envy on the water so bring your tunes.
